WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT telescref, weathprofile,
         AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex,
         AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM joined
),
kept AS (
  SELECT g.telescref, g.weathprofile, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_phaseshiftdeg,
         g.avg_modindex - x.avg_modindex AS difference
  FROM grouped AS g
  CROSS JOIN overall AS x
  WHERE g.avg_modindex > x.avg_modindex
)
SELECT weathprofile,
       AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
       AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
       AVG(difference) AS avg_difference
FROM kept
GROUP BY weathprofile
